pages.text: $(thing)Wild Tobacco$() is the natural starting point. Flowering wild tobacco can appear in Forest, Birch Forest, and Dark Forest. Breaking it can provide wild leaf and seeds. Wild seeds are $(bold)not$() sold by normal Tobacconists; a Wandering Trader may occasionally carry them as a backup source.

pages.title: The Tobacconist
pages.text: Cultivated varieties are obtained most reliably from a $(thing)Tobacconist$() villager. A Hookah is the profession's workstation. New Tobacconists always offer two cultivated seed varieties chosen for the biome where they take the profession.

pages.title: Regional Seed Trades
pages.text: $(item)Plains/default:$() Virginia + Burley$(br)$(item)Savanna:$() Virginia + Oriental$(br)$(item)Desert:$() Dokha + Oriental$(br)$(item)Badlands:$() Oriental + Dokha$(br)$(item)Jungle:$() Shade + Burley$(br)$(item)Forest:$() Burley + Shade$(br)$(item)Taiga:$() Burley + Shade$(br)$(item)Snowy:$() Burley + Virginia

pages.title: Later Trades
pages.text: Leveling a Tobacconist adds a small set of practical trades rather than replacing the seed role. Apprentices buy raw leaf from their primary regional variety and sell Rolling Paper; Journeymen sell a Clay Smoking Pipe and Tobacco Pouch; Experts sell Bamboo Charcoal and Plain Molasses; Masters sell a Tobacco Box and Tobacconist's Spectacles.

pages.title: Finding Every Variety
pages.text: A single village is not meant to provide every cultivated variety. Visit another climate to find a different regional pair. Forest and Jungle mappings also apply when a Tobacconist takes its job there, including in modded villages or relocated settlements.
